reason: The negative admission assessment is supported. The new valid consequence is a bounded demand-to-terminal projection on one handoff pattern, giving at least ceil((Q_geom+2)/3) distinct terminals and excluding that route family's all-root case. The strict-surplus [144a] account still requires a bounded charge of the original blocked pairs or source events to physical centres or arms of their handoff envelopes, or a target-relevant forbidden graph configuration. The terminal count provides no proved bounded link from those terminals to envelope incidences; distinct-terminal routes may reuse a route edge or separator. The handoff owner constructs one envelope from two selected source edges and publishes no source-wide pair-to-envelope charge. Menger linkage in the route union need not index distinct original pairs, while an H-cut need not cut G; neither outcome has a consumer. Thus eliminating the auxiliary all-root arm is not a reduction of the complete original residual. The submission retains the lemma, rejects move credit, and asserts no impossibility or closure.
